name: North Carolina Department of Information Technology
source_citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029
mission: Enable business-driven services and solutions that provide a secure and frictionless digital government experience for North Carolinians.

goals.title: Reliable and accessible technology and data services
goals.citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 6
goals.description: Ensure that the state's services are supported by reliable and accessible technology and data services.
objectives: 1.2 Create transparency for IT funding and expenditure
1.6 Mature the state's governance posture (Risk, AI, Data, EA, Service Excellence)

goals.title: AI and emerging technology in government
goals.citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 7
goals.description: Build a future-ready state with smarter, faster, trusted, and more responsive government operations through the strategic deployment of AI and emerging technologies.
objectives: 2.2 Set up statewide governance infrastructure to advance data quality, accessibility, analytics, and data literacy
2.3 Ensure that agencies are AI-ready over the next biennium
2.4 Stand up and implement the AI accelerator

goals.title: Statewide IT partnerships and digital opportunity
goals.citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 9
goals.description: Foster a statewide IT ecosystem where agencies, counties, boards, and community institutions operate as interconnected partners, advancing cybersecurity and operational efficiency through coordinated strategy.
objectives: 3.4 Scale statewide engagement to position DIT as the trusted technology partner for public sector entities
3.6 Ensure that households and businesses across the state have access to high-speed internet access, computers and digital skills (p. 12)

goals.title: Cybersecurity and resilience
goals.citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 13
goals.description: Protect North Carolina's information assets and empower government to operate with trust, agility, and confidence.
objectives: 4.1 Expand the formal, two-way partnership framework with federal, state and local agencies
4.3 Reduce North Carolina's cyber threat surface through comprehensive risk management
4.6 Foster an ongoing culture of cybersecurity awareness and education
4.8 Institute workforce programs dedicated to nurturing and advancing cybersecurity professionals

goals.title: Public-sector IT workforce
goals.citation: N.C. Department of Information Technology Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 16
goals.description: Use innovative methods to build an agile and forward-thinking public-sector IT workforce in North Carolina.
objectives: 5.1 Establish talent pipeline and entry programs based on career pathways for both technical and managerial tracks
5.3 Build the culture of continuous learning for our workforce
